Expected Control Condition: User access matches documented role requirements and unsupported access is removed.
Example Evidence Artifact: Approved role matrix, user access export, access review results
Validation Method: Compare approved access with observed access and document any extra permissions or other exceptions.

Expected Control Condition: Privileged accounts are authorized, reviewed, separated from standard use, protected with MFA, and monitored.
Example Evidence Artifact: Privileged account inventory, privileged group export, MFA configuration evidence, activity review notes
Validation Method: Confirm account ownership and review, separate admin access, MFA enforcement, and documented monitoring activity.

Expected Control Condition: Network zones are defined and inter-zone traffic is restricted by approved rules.
Example Evidence Artifact: Network diagram, VLAN list, firewall rule export, approved traffic matrix
Validation Method: Compare network zones with the diagram and compare firewall or ACL rules with the approved traffic matrix.
Frequency / Trigger: After network changes or annual review

Expected Control Condition: Remote access is authenticated, authorized, and limited to approved internal paths.
Example Evidence Artifact: VPN user list, remote access policy, authentication evidence, firewall or VPN configuration
Validation Method: Confirm authorized users, authentication requirements, approved network paths, and restrictions on unnecessary internal reachability.

Expected Control Condition: Critical authentication, firewall, endpoint, and administrative events are collected and reviewed.
Example Evidence Artifact: SIEM log source list, sample alerts, alert review notes, ingestion validation
Validation Method: Confirm required log sources are actively ingesting events and that alerts or review records show the data is being used.
Frequency / Trigger: Monthly or after log source changes

Expected Control Condition: Backups are performed and protected, selected backup information is successfully restored during testing, and recovery procedures are documented.
Example Evidence Artifact: Backup job logs, restore test report, restored sample details, recovery procedure, validation notes
Validation Method: Confirm the restore test date, selected data or system component, restoration result, reviewer, and any follow-up actions.
Frequency / Trigger: Quarterly or after major system change

Expected Control Condition: Segmentation and firewall changes are reviewed, approved, documented, implemented as authorized, and reflected in the approved baseline.
Example Evidence Artifact: Change request, approval record, implementation evidence, validation results, baseline configuration
Validation Method: Confirm the request, approval, implementation date, validation evidence, and baseline update match the deployed change.

Expected Control Condition: Weaknesses are tracked to completion with action owners, target dates, closure evidence, and validation before closure.
Example Evidence Artifact: POA&M tracker, remediation notes, closure evidence, validation record
Validation Method: Confirm each item has an owner, target date, status, remediation notes, closure evidence, and validation before closure.
